candidates.name: GetVolumePathNameW
verified_facts: GetVolumePathName returns the volume mount-point path for a specified path
The resolved root supports same-volume staging and final-path checks
semantic_limits: Mount topology can change and must be captured near the atomic move

candidates.name: FILE_STANDARD_INFO
verified_facts: FILE_STANDARD_INFO reports allocation size, end-of-file size, link count, delete-pending state, and directory state
DeletePending must be distinguished from an ordinary existing file
semantic_limits: Metadata equality does not prove byte equality or valid JSON semantics

candidates.name: FSCTL_QUERY_USN_JOURNAL
verified_facts: FSCTL_QUERY_USN_JOURNAL retrieves change-journal state for a volume
The output includes journal identity and USN boundaries
semantic_limits: Journal access and filesystem support must be recorded; absence is not proof of no changes

candidates.name: USN_JOURNAL_DATA_V2
verified_facts: USN_JOURNAL_DATA_V2 carries journal ID, first/next/lowest valid USN, size, and supported version range
Journal ID changes invalidate comparisons across journal recreation
semantic_limits: Journal boundaries do not identify which process caused a change

candidates.name: FSCTL_READ_USN_JOURNAL
verified_facts: FSCTL_READ_USN_JOURNAL retrieves records between selected USN positions
The input controls reason mask, timeout, bytes-to-wait-for, journal ID, and record versions
semantic_limits: USN records are filesystem-change evidence, not proof of successful application semantics

candidates.name: READ_USN_JOURNAL_DATA_V1
verified_facts: The structure specifies start USN, reason mask, close-only behavior, timeout, byte threshold, journal ID, and version range
Version bounds must match the records the consumer can parse
semantic_limits: Incorrect reason masks or versions can silently omit relevant records

candidates.name: USN_RECORD_V2
verified_facts: USN_RECORD_V2 includes file reference, parent reference, USN, timestamp, reason, source, attributes, and name
Record length and filename offset/length govern safe iteration
semantic_limits: A filename record requires file-ID and path reconstruction before attribution

candidates.name: FSCTL_ENUM_USN_DATA
verified_facts: FSCTL_ENUM_USN_DATA enumerates MFT records and returns USN records
It is distinct from reading recent changes by selected USN range
semantic_limits: Enumeration can be expensive and must be bounded; it does not identify a live owner

candidates.name: MFT_ENUM_DATA_V1
verified_facts: MFT_ENUM_DATA_V1 specifies start file reference, low/high USN, and supported record versions
The range and versions constrain enumeration output
semantic_limits: Broad enumeration must not be used as an unbounded recovery action

candidates.name: FSCTL_READ_FILE_USN_DATA
verified_facts: FSCTL_READ_FILE_USN_DATA returns the USN record for a specific file handle
Some returned fields such as timestamp and reason are not valid for this control code
semantic_limits: Invalid fields must not be used to infer freshness or causal changes

candidates.name: Named Pipe Operations
verified_facts: Named-pipe clients can wait for available instances and servers can accept connections
Pipe metadata and process-ID functions support endpoint diagnostics
semantic_limits: Pipe existence or availability does not prove the endpoint is the canonical runner

candidates.name: GetNamedPipeClientProcessId
verified_facts: GetNamedPipeClientProcessId returns the client process ID for a pipe instance
Function success and the exact pipe handle must be recorded
semantic_limits: PID reuse requires process start time, image path, and task correlation

candidates.name: GetNamedPipeServerProcessId
verified_facts: GetNamedPipeServerProcessId returns the server process ID for a pipe instance
The call uses an existing pipe-instance handle
semantic_limits: A server PID does not prove the protocol stream or message belongs to this task

candidates.name: GetNamedPipeInfo
verified_facts: GetNamedPipeInfo reports pipe type, buffer sizes, and maximum instances
The result describes the pipe instance or server configuration
semantic_limits: Configuration metadata does not prove connected-peer identity or message integrity
